proof_obligations.PO-SOURCE: Prove the full native label and chart law, all prefix attempts, stochastic signs, and any high-label selection conditioning. No uncharged favorable labels or outcomes.
proof_obligations.PO-PIVOT-STRUCTURE: Any low-variation pivot route must survive the all-subcode Schur/signature-space source bounds and charge all adaptive source-pool menus. Larger matrix images are not ruled out or automatically hard to invert; prove actual structure and higher-carry closure.
proof_obligations.PO-IMPLEMENTATION: Supply a uniform polynomial native partial witness finder with clean reversible transcript, BOTH directions of a chosen full transport architecture, or a genuinely branch-mixing quantum decoder. Full transport inversion is not required by the single-witness alternative. Enumeration and near-uniform histograms do not satisfy this obligation.
proof_obligations.PO-PARTIAL-WITNESS: Prove unconditional independent-full-target coverage beta for an explicit bounded shared-seed finder at m=nL+Delta, Delta at most logarithmic for this one-word filter. Use the exact original-row parity-alignment wrapper; retain every measured syndrome and charge full-rank aborts. Verify outputs, uncompute all target-dependent history, and derive fixed-secret success2^(-Delta)*rho^2. Planted, even-only or mean-per-label legal coverage does not transfer for free. Complete fiber rank/unrank, inverse finder and a second witness are not necessary here. Compose correlated prelabel noise, fresh completion and verification, all source/precision costs and named baselines before accepting any candidate.
proof_obligations.PO-DIRECT-PURIFIED-FINDER: Preferred alternative: construct a uniform bounded classical OR quantum finder for IID native A and independent uniform FULL targets at m=nL+Delta. Supply actual accessible purification and known inverse, verify Boolean outputs and preserve target control. Compute target, finder, word-match flag, XOR word away, uncompute finder and CHARGE workspace-zero herald; prove K weights are output probabilities p_t(x), full-secret success2^(-Delta)*beta_A^2 for each secret and source-average Jensen bound. No parity chart, binary-rank abort, target alignment, canonical witness, matching or final-bit completion is required in this route. Output-only black boxes, unknown advice/inverses, selected/planted coverage and excessive density do not pass. Compose original-state faults, fresh verification and all natural source/precision costs before acceptance.
proof_obligations.PO-ITERATION: The first-layer common-isotropic normalizer is reversible and low-selected. Its next quotient can have quartic low bits even when every first-layer background has full rank. Supply an actual compact higher-carry invariant and prove its conditional source law; unused random higher labels do not make the reparameterized graph a native quadratic chart.
proof_obligations.PO-TERMINAL-GEOMETRY: Near-density-one transports ending in physical affine tails must survive the native affine-plane incidence and clean rank-r compression gates. Nonlinear physical charts, interblock quantum readout, retained secret-dependent trash and increased-density sources are not ruled out, but need their own source, cost and output proofs. Do not convert a uniform-secret mean or source mean into a per-secret or per-instance bound.
proof_obligations.PO-PHASE-SEPARATION: Fixed clean junk is optional. Prove that F_A(P(t,j))-t is independent of t, or derive its actual offset-collision readout law, allowing secret-dependent junk. Clean-affine-tail geometry gates cannot reject this broader target. Implement both transport directions uniformly, charge conditional native source and all access, and test independent arithmetic targets against the exact two-forward-call baseline.
proof_obligations.PO-ACCESS: Charge every input state, evaluator, ancilla, classical preparation, measurement, precision and inverse. No fiber/reflection oracle, cloned packet or unknown preparation inverse.
proof_obligations.PO-SUCCESS: Prove source-average residue success for each fixed secret and bounded-error full-secret completion with fresh original registers. The packet loses one original secret bit per coordinate.
proof_obligations.PO-CLASSICAL: Apply the exact two-forward-call independent-uniform-target witness baseline to every classically evaluable monomial transport. This does not simulate DCP. Quantum-only access is not classical access.
proof_obligations.PO-NOISE: For correlated basis statuses use prelabel classical product-state lineage, independent fresh labels, discarded gauge data, and conditional independent fair gauge-error coins. Arbitrary correlated Z laws and entangled faults are excluded.
proof_obligations.PO-AMPLIFICATION: Preallocate disjoint independent attempts; establish fixed-secret register fault budgets, candidate commitment before verification labels, rank completion and exact false-accept tail. Do not infer conditional independence from marginals.
proof_obligations.PO-REDUCTION: Compose a successful decoder with the actual lattice source M=2^(4n), polynomial supply and total preparation/circuit perturbation below the failure margin. The current ledger is not this proof.
proof_obligations.PO-COMPARISON: Compare against named subset-sum algorithms, arithmetic baselines and quantum DCP sieves in the SAME access/parameter/noise model. No novelty or speedup from constant-size controls.
